rules_evaluated.rule_lead: The curriculum does not narrate itself — subject test, then deletion test.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Two clauses fail the rule's 2026-08-23 predicate-leak addendum ('Any clause promising what a later beat will do is cartography however the sentence starts... State the present fact; let the later module do its own work'). (1) Line 71: 'Module 4 reads this skill as part of the system you have: it walks a real task against everything you've built, and the test-strategy skill is the quality-criterion anchor in that walk.' -- subject passes (this is under 'What this sets up', an exempt signposting-adjacent section by convention) but the predicate promises what Module 4's own body will do, which is exactly the shape Antti's same-day compounded correction (`2026-08-23-student_facing-later-module-predicate-is-still-cartography.md`) fixed elsewhere in the corpus. (2) Line 67, trailing clause of the **What happened:** block: 'The module's close sharpens it from what the invocation showed.' -- promises what a later beat (M3's own close section, a different file) will do to this artifact. Neither clause has a maintainer accept-note authorizing it; the file's maintainer block was checked and carries no dated exception for either passage. Harm: this is cartography with a friendlier face -- it binds a beat this file doesn't own to a shape it may not take, and goes stale silently if M3's close or M4's design changes without anyone re-reading this exercise file. Verified against `earn-the-trust.md` (M3's own module file, line 177): M4 does currently read the test-strategy skill this way, so the claim happens to be true today -- but the rule bans the SHAPE regardless of current accuracy, precisely because truth-today doesn't protect against staleness-tomorrow.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Rewrite both to present-tense facts about the student's own artifact, per the compendium's own counter-example pattern ('Everyone sees how this will bloat almost immediately' style -- state what is true now, not what a later beat will do). Line 71 candidate: cut the 'Module 4 reads...' clause and let line 72 alone carry the section (it already lands correctly on the student's own artifact). Line 67 candidate: end the What-happened block at 'Shipped.' per check_writing.md §16 Move 3 (land on the destination) and cut the trailing clause entirely.
